shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; cat AGENTS.md; ls -R .agents | head -50

head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ------; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; echo -----; cat index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore; ls -R src __agent_eval__; cat src/*; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>&1; ls node_modules | head -30
npm install @gravity-ui/uikit 2>&1 | tail -15; node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs; cat $D/INDEX.md | head -60; ls $D/components $D/guides; grep -n -i -A12 "required setup\|## Setup\|ThemeProvider" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -60

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs; ls $D/components/controls; sed -n 60,140p $D/INDEX.md; grep -n "ThemeProvider\|Provider" $D/guides/migration-to-v8.md | head; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider TextInput Checkbox Button Card Text Flex 2>&1 | head -60

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components; grep -n -i "^#\|label\|validationState\|errorMessage\|errorPlacement\|autoComplete\|type=\|onUpdate\|size" $D/controls/TextInput.md | head -50; echo ----PW; grep -n -i "^#\|PasswordInput\|hideRevealButton\|autoComplete" $D/controls/PasswordInput.md | head -25; echo ----CB; grep -n -i "^#\|content\|onUpdate\|checked\|name" $D/Checkbox.md 2>/dev/null | head -20; ls $D | grep -i check; echo ---BTN; grep -n -i "type\|loading\|width\|size\|view" $D/Button.md | head -30; echo ---CARD; grep -n -i "^#\|view\|type=\|size" $D/Card.md | head -20; echo ---TEXT; grep -n "variant\|color" $D/Text.md | head -12

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components; sed -n 17,32p $D/controls/PasswordInput.md; sed -n 30,60p $D/Card.md; grep -n "width\|type \|| type\|loading" $D/Button.md | tail -12; grep -n "theme\|rootClassName" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/theming.md | head -12; grep -n "gap\|direction\|alignItems" $D/../guides/layout.md | head -10

sed -n 36,60p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/layout.md; grep -rn "type?" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -3; grep -n "direction\|flexDirection" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Flex/*.d.ts | head -5; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/ 2>/dev/null | head

grep -n "type" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head; grep -n "autoFocus\|autoComplete\|type?" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts | head; sed -n 1,60p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts | grep -n "Props\|type" | head
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15; git status --short
